verdict_detail: wrapper-free information-content test: Spearman rank IC between the causal cross-sectional near-to-far ATM IV atm_iv basis (ETH - BTC) and the subsequent forward relative realized return tail-asymmetry spread (tail_asym_BTC - tail_asym_ETH) on the real on-disk captures

floor.note: EVAL-77 consumes both underlyings' trade-tape IV surfaces and both perp series. It composes the sealed EVAL-71 surface floor (applied to BOTH BTC and ETH, reused verbatim, neither weakened) with a cross-sectional alignment floor (>= min_aligned_common_bars bar-ends where both underlyings carry a causal near-ATM IV on the coarsest grid). This is NOT the EVAL-64 options-surface snapshot floor, which governs the EVAL-67/68/69 ladder and is untouched here.

protocol.title: Cross-sectional causal near-to-far ATM implied-vol atm_iv basis (ETH - BTC) -> subsequent forward relative realized return tail-asymmetry spread (Spearman rank IC) predictiveness on the real on-disk captures
protocol.extends: EVAL-77 (cross-sectional surface basis atm_iv+skew -> forward realized-vol spread) and EVAL-105/106 (cross-sectional term_ratio/term_slope basis -> forward relative tail-asymmetry spread) and EVAL-110 (cross-sectional skew basis -> forward relative tail-asymmetry spread) and EVAL-128 (cross-sectional atm_iv basis -> forward relative return skewness spread): same Spearman rank-IC statistic and sealed signal reconstructions reused verbatim, but a distinct on-charter signal x target cell — the *cross-sectional* atm_iv basis (atm_iv[ETH] - atm_iv[BTC]) -> forward *relative realized return tail-asymmetry spread*; no new acquisition
protocol.supersedes: nothing — complements EVAL-77/105/106/110/127/128; makes no traded-form claim

cross_section.target: spread_k = tail_asym_BTC(k) - tail_asym_ETH(k) with tail_asym_i(k) = (q95 - median) - (median - q05) over the next H perp log returns strictly after k (relative tail-asymmetry spread)

protocol.signal: causal per-bar near-ATM implied vol surface (EVAL-71 build_surface_bars, atm_iv field) for BTC and ETH; the relative series (ETH - BTC) is forward-filled then expanding-z-scored end-of-bar k (reused e77._relative_signal_series / e61.expanding_zscore)
protocol.target: forward realized-return tail asymmetry = (q95 - median) - (median - q05) of log returns over the next H perp bars, computed per underlying on the common aligned bar grid; target = tail_asym_BTC - tail_asym_ETH (relative realized return tail-asymmetry spread)
protocol.statistic: Spearman rank correlation IC = rho(rel_z_k, spread_k) over the common aligned bar-ends (H1: IC > 0)

stats.permutation: directional (H1: IC>0), shuffle the relative forward-return-tail-asymmetry spread

protocol.go_bar: GO only if at least one config (signal x bar grid x horizon) has Spearman IC > 0, directional permutation p < 0.05, block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, at least min_usable_pairs_per_config usable pairs, and pooled BH-FDR rejects that config; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS).

data_availability.note: uses the already-acquired real on-disk three-way captures (option trades with real iv + perp candles for BTC and ETH); no new acquisition, no network; composes the EVAL-71 surface floor for both underlyings with a cross-sectional alignment floor

floor.note: EVAL-77 consumes both underlyings' trade-tape IV surfaces and both perp series. It composes the sealed EVAL-71 surface floor (applied to BOTH BTC and ETH, reused verbatim, neither weakened) with a cross-sectional alignment floor (>= min_aligned_common_bars bar-ends where both underlyings carry a causal near-ATM IV on the coarsest grid). This is NOT the EVAL-64 options-surface snapshot floor, which governs the EVAL-67/68/69 ladder and is untouched here.
